description: Mi nombre es Fátima Isabel Quintero Moreno, tengo 17 años. mis intereses son ver como podemos utilizar como herramienta información de observación de la Tierra de la NASA, junto con datos locales sobre el suelo, el clima, la disponibilidad de agua y las características de los cultivos.  Mis habilidades son, la lectura, la investigación y el deporte.
summary:
AgroSpace is a project that aims to transform agriculture through space technology and NASA satellite data. We developed GreenOrbit, an application that analyzes climate information, temperature, humidity, rainfall, and soil conditions to identify agricultural risks such as droughts and climate changes.

Our solution addresses the challenge by using Earth observation data to provide recommendations about crops, irrigation systems, and sustainable farming practices. This helps farmers make better decisions and adapt their crops to changing environmental conditions.

This project is important because it helps address the effects of climate change, optimize water use, protect soil health, and promote more efficient and sustainable agriculture. It also brings space technology closer to farming communities, turning scientific data into a useful tool for the future of food production.
details:
GreenOrbit is an application that uses NASA satellite data to help farmers understand weather and soil conditions. It analyzes temperature, humidity, and rainfall to identify risks such as droughts and provide recommendations about irrigation and crops.

Benefits: It helps save water, protect soil, and prevent agricultural losses.

Expected Impact: Promote sustainable agriculture and help farmers adapt to climate change.

Tools Used: NASA data, Climate Engine, QGIS, and Jotform.

Creativity: It combines space technology with agriculture, turning scientific data into simple and useful recommendations.

Factors Considered: Weather conditions, soil moisture, water availability, crop needs, and environmental protection.
